newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Swire's to sell more Island Place flats.
newsitem.headline: Swire's to sell more Island Place flats.

text.p: Swire Properties Ltd, a unit of Swire Pacific Ltd, said its received 141 registrations from potential buyers for units on offer in the fifth phase of its Island Place development on Hong Kong Island.
"This is about 1.2 times oversubscribed on the 64 units on offer," a spokesman of the company told Reuters on Sunday.

The units in North Point would be sold at an average price of HK$8,998 per square foot, about 13-percent higher than HK$7,966 per sq ft for the last batch of units on sale in the fourth phase in January, he said.
Swire's senior management would decide later whether to increase the number of units on offer, the spokesman said.
Actual sales would start on Wednesday, he added. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6369
